Re-found by EXP-C05-07 and Lean-certified (E677_order16_law, E1313_order16_law, kernel decide on the 16 x 16 tables).

history.new: Supported only by n <= 10 with orders 8 and 10 undecided within budget (both laws in 5, 7, 9; out 2, 3, 4, 6); the small models are idempotent quasigroups. Weak evidence; recorded to direct the next search. The search had a blind spot - affine models were tried only over Z_n (cyclic additive group), never over GF(2^k). Whether the odd part holds, and which even orders below 16 occur (8, 10, 12, 14), is open; the Skeptic found no affine model of order 8 over any abelian group of order 8 and none over Z_10.
